categories.main_business_segments: AIG operates through three main business segments: General Insurance, Life and Retirement, and Other Operations. General Insurance is further divided into North America and International, offering property casualty and specialty insurance. Life and Retirement includes Individual Retirement, Group Retirement, Life Insurance, and Institutional Markets. Other Operations primarily comprises corporate activities, asset management, and run-off portfolios.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: AIG's core operations rely on advanced actuarial modeling, risk assessment, and underwriting methodologies for insurance products. The company leverages data analytics, digital platforms, and technology-driven distribution and claims management systems. Asset-liability management and economic hedging strategies are central to managing investment and insurance risks, particularly for products with embedded guarantees.
categories.primary_customers_markets: AIG serves a broad range of customers, including multinational corporations, small and medium-sized businesses, high-net-worth individuals, and retail consumers. Its primary markets include commercial and personal insurance, retirement solutions, and institutional products, with a strong presence in the U.S. and select international markets. Key end markets include property and casualty insurance, life insurance, annuities, pension risk transfer, and specialty insurance lines.
categories.geographic_coverage: AIG operates in approximately 70 countries and jurisdictions, with significant business in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Latin America. About 34% of employees are in North America, 43% in Asia Pacific, and the remainder in EMEA and Latin America. The company maintains a global footprint with offices and subsidiaries in major insurance markets worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: AIG operates primarily as a downstream provider in the insurance and financial services supply chain, delivering risk transfer, asset protection, and retirement solutions directly to end customers and intermediaries. It also acts as a reinsurer and cedes certain risks to third-party reinsurers for capital and risk management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: AIG's strategic focus is on profitable growth, underwriting and operational excellence, modernization of its operating infrastructure (AIG 200 initiative), and digital transformation. The company emphasizes innovation in product design, risk management, and customer experience, with ongoing investments in technology, data analytics, and automation. Strategic partnerships, such as with BlackRock and Blackstone for asset management, support its focus on capital efficiency and investment performance.
categories.revenue_model: AIG generates revenue primarily from insurance premiums, policy fees, and investment income. Additional revenue streams include advisory fees, asset management fees, and income from structured products and reinsurance arrangements. Profitability depends on effective risk pricing, claims management, investment returns, and expense control.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AIG competes with global and regional insurance companies, banks, and other financial institutions, including Chubb, Allianz, Zurich, MetLife, Prudential, and others. It is positioned as a leading global insurer with strong market share in commercial lines, U.S. retirement solutions, and specialty insurance. The company differentiates itself through its global reach, underwriting expertise, and breadth of product offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2022, AIG reported total revenues of $56.4 billion and net income attributable to common shareholders of $10.2 billion. The company has over $526 billion in total assets and $40 billion in shareholders’ equity. While AIG has demonstrated strong profitability and capital management, growth is moderate, with a focus on improving underwriting margins and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AIG emphasizes its world-class insurance franchises, global reach, and ability to provide tailored risk solutions to a diverse client base. Its value proposition centers on underwriting expertise, financial strength, broad product portfolio, and deep distribution relationships. The company highlights its ability to deliver innovative, client-centric solutions and operational excellence, supported by a strong balance sheet and advanced risk management capabilities.
